name: select
title: Select
description: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from, triggered by a button.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: The autocomplete attribute for the hidden select. Enables browser autofill (e.g. "address-level1" for state).

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether the select should close after an item is selected

props.name: composite
props.description: Whether the select is a composed with other composite widgets like tabs or combobox

props.name: defaultHighlightedValue
props.description:
The initial value of the highlighted item when opened.
Use when you don't need to control the highlighted value of the select.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the select's open state is controlled by the user

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial default value of the select when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the select.

props.name: deselectable
props.description:
Whether the value can be cleared by clicking the selected item.

**Note:** this is only applicable for single selection

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the select is disabled

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the underlying select.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: highlightedValue
props.description: The controlled key of the highlighted item

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the select. Useful for composition.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the select is invalid

props.name: label
props.description:
Field label rendered above the trigger (NOT the shadcn listbox group
label — see `select-label` note on the group label below).

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether to loop the keyboard navigation through the options

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether to allow multiple selection

props.name: name
props.description: The `name` attribute of the underlying select.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the select menu is open

props.name: positioning
props.description: The positioning options of the menu.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the select is read-only

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the select is required

props.name: scrollToIndexFn
props.description: Function to scroll to a specific index

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled keys of the selected items

events.name: onFocusOutside
events.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

events.name: onHighlightChange
events.description: The callback fired when the highlighted item changes.

events.name: onInteractOutside
events.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Function called when the popup is opened

events.name: onPointerDownOutside
events.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

events.name: onSelect
events.description: Function called when an item is selected

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: The callback fired when the selected item changes.

keyboard.description: Opens the listbox. When open, selects the highlighted item.
Opens the listbox, or moves the highlight to the next/previous item.
Moves the highlight to the first/last item.
Typing characters jumps the highlight to the next matching item's label.
Closes the listbox without changing the selection.
Closes the listbox and moves focus to the next focusable element.

accessibilityNotes: The trigger renders as a native `<button>` with `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls` wired by the Zag select machine.
A hidden native `<select>` mirrors the current items and value so the component participates in native form submission and browser autofill.
Pass `label` for a visible field label, or omit it to fall back to a screen-reader-only label built from `placeholder`.
Set `invalid` on a wrapping `Field` plus `aria-invalid` on `Select` to announce an error state — see the Invalid example.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Pass an `items` array of `{ value, label }` entries.

examples.title: Align item with trigger
examples.description: Upstream toggles a real item-aligned positioning mode; @zag-js/select has no such concept, so this demo wires the switch to the closest analog — a `positioning.placement` change, which swaps edge anchoring from bottom to top but never makes the selected item overlap the trigger the way upstream's mode does.

examples.title: Groups
examples.description: Pass `groups=` — an array of `{ label, items }` — to render labeled, separated option groups.

examples.title: Scrollable
examples.description: A select with many grouped items that scrolls within the viewport.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: A disabled select is skipped by the tab order and ignores pointer input.

examples.title: Invalid
examples.description: Set `invalid` on `Field` and `aria-invalid` on `Select` to show an error state.

examples.title: RTL
examples.description: Pass `dir="rtl"` — a real machine prop — to drive both the DOM attribute and Zag's RTL-aware keyboard and positioning logic.

examples.title: With label
examples.description: Pass `label` to render a visible label instead of a screen-reader-only one.

examples.title: Default value
examples.description: Pass `defaultValue` to set the initial selection without controlling it.

examples.title: Disabled items
examples.description: Set `disabled: true` on individual entries in `items` to skip them.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source: import Select from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/select/select.marko"; static const fruits = [ { value: "apple", label: "Apple" }, { value: "banana", label: "Banana" }, { value: "blueberry", label: "Blueberry" }, { value: "grapes", label: "Grapes" }, { value: "pineapple", label: "Pineapple" }, ];
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`.

examples.title: Compound (attr tags)
examples.source:
import Select from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/select/select.marko";

<Select placeholder="Select a fruit">
  <@option value="apple" label="Apple"/>
  <@option value="banana" label="Banana"/>
  <@option value="blueberry" label="Blueberry"/>
  <@option value="grapes" label="Grapes"/>
  <@option value="pineapple" label="Pineapple"/>
</Select>
examples.description: Use `<@option>` attribute tags instead of `items=` to compose each option directly in markup.

composition:
Select is a single unsplit component — it has no separate trigger/content/item
parts to compose. Its anatomy (all internal, rendered from `items=` or
`groups=`) mirrors upstream's tree:

```text
Select
├── select-field-label      (visible label, or sr-only when omitted)
├── select-control
│   └── select-trigger
│       ├── select-value
│       └── select-trigger-icon
└── select-positioner        (portalled)
    └── select-content
        ├── select-scroll-up-button
        ├── select-viewport
        │   └── select-group        (only when `groups=` is used)
        │       ├── select-label
        │       └── select-item × N
        │           ├── select-item-indicator
        │           └── select-item-text
        └── select-scroll-down-button
```

Use `items=` for a flat list, `groups=` for the grouped/labeled/separated
layout above, or the `<@option>` attribute tag to compose options directly in
markup (see the Compound example below).
